items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: In fact, his Dad used to come to the (?) room and jam with us. So did Harry.

ctx.x: Not as I... Now, Harry James at one time was on a circus. Harry James was born on a circus. They had a circus out of Galveston, Texas, called the Christy Brothers, and his father was a leader. In fact, his Dad used to come to the (?) room and jam with us. So did Harry. But Harry was on this circus.

It's funny. You seem to have pursued this career different from most of the New Orleans-Baton Rouge, whatever-those-towns-were musicians... You were involved in the medicine shows and the circus and all. Did you ever yearn to go back to New Orleans or Baton Rouge? Or you didn't care?
